explication: JUCE is a cross-platform C++ application framework and project-generation tool. Developers either configure JUCE through CMake or use Projucer to model and export projects, then build applications, audio plug-ins, or plug-in hosts from JUCE modules. Runtime applications consume GUI, messaging, audio-device, scripting, MIDI-CI, and optional ARA services to produce interactive or audio results. The graph emphasizes documented capabilities and sampled module behavior; several broad framework APIs are represented by their exact enclosing module directories because their implementations were not sampled.
